name: campus-feedback-system
description: Campus Honest and Transparent Feedback System (Thapar University)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "AUTH,FEEDBACK,GATEWAY,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green,magenta,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix auth-service" "npm run dev --prefix feedback-microservice" "npm run dev --prefix gateway" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "AUTH,FEEDBACK,GATEWAY,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green,magenta,cyan" "npm start --prefix auth-service" "npm start --prefix feedback-microservice" "npm start --prefix gateway" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix auth-service && npm install --prefix feedback-microservice && npm install --prefix gateway && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.otp: node --env-file=auth-service/.env -e "import('./auth-service/src/lib/prisma.js').then(async ({default: p}) => { const otps = await p.otpVerification.findMany({orderBy: {createdAt: 'desc'}, take: 5}); console.table(otps.map(o => ({ Email: o.email, OTP: o.otp, Time: o.createdAt.toLocaleTimeString() }))); process.exit(0); })"
